# RIOT FEST (14 · riot)

A festival poster that bites back — kinetic letters, opposing marquees, acid-on-black stages.

- **Technique:** KINETIC TYPE
- **Tags:** festival, music, bold, kinetic, poster, loud, neon, youth
- **Best for:** festivals; concerts; events; streetwear
- **Fonts:** Anton, Archivo

- **Swatch:** #0a0a0a · #c6ff00 · #ff2e88
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers

## Signature effects
- `riotType.ts`
  - `initRiotType(root: HTMLElement)` — Split each `.row[data-word]` into hoverable `.ch` letters. Unless the user prefers reduced motion, every letter drops in from above (row 1) or below (row 2) with a stagger. Once it has landed the inline styles are cleared, so the stylesheet's hover transform applies (inline `transform: none` would otherwise mask it).
- `scatter.ts`
  - `scatterSvg()` — Build-time hero doodles: 16 outlined stars, rings, squiggles and squares scattered with a seeded PRNG (so the layout is identical on every build). Strokes reference palette tokens via `var()`.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<span>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Lineup size: 1 is a solid headliner, 2 an outlined second line, 3 small dim type. */
export type ActTier = 1 | 2 | 3;

export interface Act {
  name: string;
  /** Day · stage · time, revealed on hover (desktop only). */
  slot: string;
  tier: ActTier;
  href: string;
}

export interface Stage {
  name: string;
  /** Capacity line, e.g. "CAP 30,000". */
  cap: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface Tier {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  /** Unit after the price, e.g. "/day". */
  unit: string;
  perks: string[];
  /** Diagonal ribbon across the corner, e.g. "SOLD OUT". */
  ribbon?: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo in the nav and footer; wrap the accented half in `<em>`. */
  brandHtml: string;
  /** Nav links before the ticket sticker. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** Tilted acid-green nav sticker. */
  navCta: Link;
  hero: {
    /** Date/venue/tagline pieces, joined by `dateSeparator`. */
    dates: string[];
    dateSeparator: string;
    /** The two big words. Each letter is split out and reacts to hover. */
    title: [string, string];
    /** Accessible name for the split title. */
    titleLabel: string;
    subHtml: string;
    /** Hint under the sub line (desktop only). */
    hint: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  /** Two opposing marquee strips (first scrolls left, second right); each repeats its items endlessly. */
  marquees: { items: string[] }[];
  /** Glyph after every marquee item. */
  marqueeSeparator: string;
  lineup: {
    /** Anchor id of the section (nav links target it). */
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    acts: Act[];
    /** Italic line after the last act. */
    more: string;
  };
  stages: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Stage[];
  };
  tickets: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    tiers: Tier[];
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Credit line; the showcase line is appended on showcase routes. */
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
